explanation: I found no Mathlib match. The statement is built entirely on the library's own definitions: `IntervalRat`, `evalTaylorSeries`, `atanhTaylorCoeffs` and `singleton`. The proof just applies the library's own lemma `mem_evalTaylorSeries` to the singleton interval of `q`, so all of the content lives in the library's interval-arithmetic code. Mathlib has no rational-interval Taylor-series evaluator or atanh coefficient list that it could restate, so I did not run a wider search.
